subheading: Amendments, new standards, and certification deadlines that affect BIS-regulated products.

r1.title: Clarification on pressure cooker marking requirements
r1.description: BIS issued a clarification on the marking and safety-valve labelling requirements under IS 2347 for pressure cookers.

r2.title: ISO 9001:2026 revision aligns with BIS clauses
r2.description: The revised ISO 9001 quality-management clauses are now cross-referenced in BIS certification scheme audits.

r3.title: LED luminaires move to mandatory QCO
r3.description: The certification scheme for LED luminaires transitioned from voluntary to a mandatory Quality Control Order.

r4.title: New Indian Standard published for toy safety
r4.description: IS 9873 (Part 1):2025 was published, covering mechanical and physical safety requirements for toys.

r5.title: Amendment to IS 4151:2025 (protective helmets)
r5.description: BIS notified an amendment to Clause 7.2 covering chin-strap strength requirements for protective helmets.

r6.title: Licence transition deadline for household appliances
r6.description: Existing licences under IS 302 must transition to the IS 302 (Part 2):2026 revision by this date.

r7.title: Draft QCO for packaged drinking water opens for comment
r7.description: A draft Quality Control Order for IS 14543 (packaged drinking water) opens for public comment.

r8.title: Mandatory hallmarking extends to lighter jewellery
r8.description: Mandatory hallmarking under IS 1417 extends to gold jewellery items below 2 grams.

r9.title: Public review opens for gold alloy standard amendment
r9.description: A proposed amendment to IS 1417 (gold and gold alloys) opens for public review and comment.

r10.title: IEC 60335 household appliance safety revision in force
r10.description: The revised IEC 60335 household appliance safety standard enters into force internationally.
